gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.

gaps.explanation: 'Her persistence' — the quality noun from persistent.

gaps.sentence: The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: The two sides failed to reach an ___ (AGREE).
